results.title: Brinker International (EAT) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
results.description: Shares of casual restaurant chain Brinker International (NYSE:EAT) jumped 12.3% in the afternoon session after the company reported mixed fiscal fourth-quarter results but issued a strong outlook for its upcoming 2027 financial year. While Brinker International's adjusted earnings of $3.07 per share narrowly missed Wall Street's estimates, revenue of $1.54 billion came in ahead of forecasts, supported by an increase in same-store sales.
